sections.text: Dark God of Wild Protection XL

[Effects]
Physical and magic damage taken reduces by S+ - XL based on the dark elemental defense value.
Nullifies Confuse.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.
When an Ability that causes Confuse is used against you.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate against Light enemies increases to L.
